summary: The repeat of the original restart probe (receipt e0ef28c2bc89481aa6b3af478422de7c) reproduced all three modes with the same values — empty configuration and no leadership after restart with RestoreCommittedLogs (violated, witness 1), while the non-replay mode (index 3) and the snapshot mode (index 5) both keep their configuration and lead — so the primary witness and its in-harness controls reproduce together. I also checked the captured documentation for a caller restriction that could defeat the premise: RestoreCommittedLogs and CommitTrackingLogStore appear only in config.go, log.go and api.go and never in README.md, docs/, membership.md or CHANGELOG.md, while those files do discuss snapshots elsewhere, so the search is sound; the only normative text is the Config field comment, which requires the commit-tracking store but says nothing about snapshots or configuration recovery. That negative result is recorded with the parent interpretation, along with the honest note that the two control modes in this multi-mode harness are scored unknown and the scored control comes from the separate isolated-control receipt.
